author: ValWood
body: We have a lot of proteasome-dependent catabolic process terms that are identical except for whether they mention ubiquitin dependence. However, the ubiquitin dependency is really an activity which is usually (but perhaps not always) part of the pathway. The ubiquitin dependency should be modelled in a GO-CAM rather than captured in the term label (similar to these which are obsoleted, or pending GO:0030433 obsolete ubiquitin-dependent ERAD pathway GO:0030579 obsolete ubiquitin-dependent SMAD protein catabolic process GO:1903069 obsolete regulation of ER-associated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process GO:1903070 obsolete negative regulation of ER-associated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process GO:1903071 obsolete positive regulation of ER-associated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process GO:0070086 ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis applies to terms highlighted in yellow here:
title: ubquitin-dependent catabolic process terms  (propose obsoletions)
